comparison.objective: Move an open bound volume into an imaging cradle while respecting its opening limit; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support of a fragile articulated volume and four-strip placement versus counterheld tool use, collar adjustment, and response-guided calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Four bearing contacts, clear binding, hands released, and opening limit respected versus two safe dynamic stops and bounded setting drift.
comparison.reason: Bimanual support is shared only generically; the tested mechanics and outcomes differ.
